item.title: LaGrange holds off late rally from Upson-Lee
item.description: The LaGrange girls basketball team was able to hold off a late rally from Upson-Lee on Friday to earn a clutch region win. The Grangers walked off the floor with a 57-49 victory. item.title: Troup rallies to beat Lanett
item.description: The Troup boys basketball team had to dig deep to pull out a 54-52 road win over Lanett (AL) last Friday. The Panthers looked like they would run away with the game early after taking a 24-13 advantage to the second quarter.
